The '''"Teklos" Mobile Command Base''' was originally designed as a commercial [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] version of [[Nen-Carvon]]'s [[PX-4 Mobile Command Base]]. It was intended to serve as protection for corporate officials and high-ranking civilians. Because of its combination of firepower, protection, and comfort, it quickly became favored by [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]] across the [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was first adapted on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Teklos]] to combat [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gangs]].
